transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm just having a hard time lately. 

Most days, it just feels like... I don't know, like I'm sitting at the bottom of a dark hole. Even when I'm around people I know, I just... I can't seem to shake it. It's just this heavy, hopeless feeling.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... about a year and two months, I guess. 

It started after I took a fall at my HVAC job. I ended up with a back injury from it, and... I don't know. Everything just kind of started unraveling after that.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

Not really. Um... I used to do things. Hiking, painting... I used to like tinkering down at the makerspace. I even liked figuring out a tricky install on the job. 

But... I don't know. Now I just sort of stare at my supplies. People call and I just ignore it. None of it really feels worth starting anymore.
Have you ever thought about harming yourself or ending your life?

Um... I don't really like talking about this. 

But... yeah. I guess sometimes I just think... it might be better for everyone if I just didn't wake up. When the pain gets really bad, and the money worries just keep piling up... I catch myself thinking about... just ending it. It scares me, honestly, to think like that. But... yeah. The thoughts are there.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level or how you're moving compared to before you started feeling this way?

Yeah... I guess so. Just... everything is slow now. 

Even just getting from the couch to the kitchen. It's... I don't know, it just takes me longer to do anything. Even answering a simple question takes longer than it should. People keep asking if I'm okay... they say I move like I'm underwater. So... yeah. I guess I'm just slow.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to, or is it more that you just can't seem to get started on things?
I mean... I think I just answered that. It's both, I guess. But yeah, mostly... everything is just slow. Like I said... moving around, thinking... it's all just... slow.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight since you started feeling this way?

I haven't really been on a scale... but... my eating is just all over the place. 

I'll usually go most of the day just on coffee. Food kind of... turns my stomach right now. And then... I don't know, late at night, I just end up picking at whatever's in the cabinet. I don't even really taste it. So... yeah. I guess things have changed.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard any voices that others couldn't hear since you started feeling this way?
No. I haven't... nothing like that. I don't hear voices.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt somewhat better, or has it been a constant feeling of being at the bottom?
Not really. It's just... all been the same. I haven't had any good days, if that's what you mean. It's just... constant, I guess.
Would you say that these feelings of hopelessness and sadness are interfering with your ability to work or take care of things at home most of the time?

Yeah... I guess you could say that. I just... I haven't really been keeping up with things. 

The field work... the business side of my jobs... I'm just falling behind. Missing calls. Deadlines. Even bills I used to just handle without thinking about it. And... I don't know, I'm not really seeing friends much right now. Or going to the makerspace. I mostly just... stay home. Just trying to get through the day, I guess.
Would you say these feelings have been present every day since they started?

Yeah... every day. It's been like this for... I don't know, about a year and two months now. Ever since I took that fall at an HVAC job and hurt my back... it just seems like everything started falling apart after that.
Would you say that there are any times of the day when your sadness or hopelessness feels worse than others?
I don't really know. Um... not that I've noticed, anyway. It just sort of... stays the same, I guess. Morning or night, it doesn't really make a difference.
Would you say your feelings of sadness or hopelessness are extremely severe, or are they more moderate?

I guess... severe. It's just really heavy. Most days it feels like... I don't know, like I'm sitting at the bottom of a dark hole. Even if I'm around people I know, I just... I can't shake that hopeless feeling.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
No... not really. I don't think so. Just... what I told you before.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep since you started feeling this way?

Um... yeah, I guess. It's... not great. Sometimes I just lie awake for hours. Just... my back hurting, thinking about bills and stuff. Or... I don't know, other times I'll sleep half the day away. But... it doesn't really matter. I still wake up feeling like I never even rested.
Do you often feel restless or have an inability to sit still?

No... not restless. I mostly just... sit there. If anything, it's the opposite. Everything I do is just... slow now. 

Like getting from the couch to the kitchen... it just takes me longer than it should. Even answering a simple question takes a minute. People keep asking if I'm okay... they say I move like I'm underwater or something. So... no, I don't really have trouble sitting still.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

Um... no. Not really. 

I used to do things. Like... hiking, or painting. Tinkering around at the makerspace. Even at work, I used to actually like figuring out a tricky install. But... I don't know. Not anymore. Now I mostly just... stare at the supplies. People call and I just ignore the phone. It just... none of it really feels worth starting.
Are there any small things that you still look forward to or enjoy, like a favorite meal or a warm bath?

No... not really. Like I was just saying... even with the small stuff, I just don't care. 

Food is just... whatever. A bath just sounds like too much effort. It's all just like the painting or the makerspace I mentioned. I don't look forward to any of it. It's all just... not worth the effort to even start.
Do you feel like you're able to experience any pleasure when good things happen to you, or are you unable to react to them at all?

I don't know... I guess I just don't react much. Like I said before... I used to like things. Hiking, painting... even the tricky installs at work. But now... good things, bad things... it doesn't matter. I just stare at my painting supplies. I ignore my phone. It's just... none of it makes me feel anything anymore.
Would you say that your feelings of sadness or hopelessness are more like a gentle fog or a heavy weight that's always there?

A heavy weight... yeah. 

It's... I don't know. Most days I just feel like I'm sitting at the bottom of a dark hole. It's just this... heavy, hopeless feeling. Even if I'm around people I know, I just... I can't shake it.
